messages:
olivia: Morning — quick pulse from route owners. Post what you did yesterday / blockers / today. Ping if you need pairing.

sam: merged the route policy refactor PR (#432) into staging. No blockers. Observed ~5% increase in 95p latency on short requests in staging; running more load tests.

lee: reproduced the spike locally with the minimal load generator. Suspect batcher misconfig for tiny payloads (batch size floor). Will open issue+hotfix PR today.

maria: rotated JWT signing key in staging last night. No auth failures seen in basic smoke. Will run full smoke against dedicated later. @sam please add the new key thumbprint to gw config.

sam: will add thumbprint to Vault and update gw config; ETA ~2h. curl smoke I used:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://gw.staging.internal/_health
```

noah: finished rate-limit quota audit. Flag: per-route burst behavior is undefined for some legacy routes. Suggest adding a per-route burst SLO. @olivia can we slot this for next sprint? :calendar:

olivia: yes — add to sprint board and assign to noah. I'll sync with product about acceptable burst windows.

tim: infra note — service account used by third-party metrics pipeline needs read access to route metrics. Opening infra PR now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route-policy-hotfix on staging (deploy-1734567890). 4/4 replicas updated. No errors in logs.

sam: confirmed hotfix reduced 95p by ~12% in staging load tests. Planning to promote to prod canary after lunch unless objections.

lee: small blocker — hitting a token expiry 401 in ~0.2% of requests when clients reuse cached tokens. @maria can you pair at 11:30 to debug?

maria: 11:30 works; will join and bring token logs.

olivia: perfect. If anything blocks the prod push, ping #eng-oncall and @olivia. Thanks everyone, end of pulse.
